```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
Y <- read_csv("simdata/Y_sim.csv", col_names = FALSE) |>
  as.matrix() |>
  scale()

stan_data <- list(
  T        = nrow(Y),
  N        = ncol(Y),
  Y        = Y,
  p        = 2,
  xi_split = c(4, 4),
  xi_own   = rep(1, 4),
  xi_cross = rep(1, 4),
  mean_R2  = 0.666,
  prec_R2  = 3,
  sigma_sd = 2
)
```

```{r}
mod_arr2 <- cmdstan_model(
  "models/var-arr2.stan",
  stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE)
)

fit_arr2 <- mod_arr2$sample(
  data = stan_data,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 0,
  show_messages = FALSE,
  show_exceptions = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
fit_arr2$diagnostic_summary()
fit_arr2$summary(c("alpha", "A", "sigma", "R2", "w"))
```
